props.name: placement
props.description: Which side of the trigger it opens on. Flips when it would leave the viewport.

props.name: align
props.description: How it lines up with the trigger along that side.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Omit to let the menu manage its own.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the menu opens or closes. Pair with `open` to control it.
